+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+## Usage
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts template.txt data.json
+```
+
+The CLI writes only rendered output to stdout. Errors are written to stderr and return a non-zero status.
+
+## Syntax
+
+- `{{path}}` renders HTML-escaped scalar text.
+- `{{{path}}}` renders unescaped scalar text.
+- `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` renders a conditional block.
+- `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}` iterates an array.
+- `{{this}}` and `{{@index}}` refer to the current item and index in a loop.
+- `{{! comment }}` renders nothing.
+
+Run the self-tests with `bun test`.
